description: Potentials on {0..k-1} (lists of integers) used by scripts/check_facet_criterion.py and scripts/check_facets_without_total_support.py. Every stated property is recomputed by those scripts in exact arithmetic.

potentials.name: example_5_1_chi
potentials.description: Example 5.1: indicator of O = {2,4,5,7,9,10,11,12,13}. A ray (dim Z = 3) of height two whose inequality defines a facet of hat-P(19); its tight graph does not have total support (19 lost tight pairs, all containing 16 and not 11); the allowed graph meets every anti-diagonal, has the bipartite component {11,16}, bip = 1, dim Z* = 4.

potentials.name: remark_5_2_chi_prime
potentials.description: Remark 5.2: chi' = chi - e_11 + e_16, the indicator of (O minus {11}) plus {16}. Same v and same sum as chi, a ray, not in span{1, iota, chi}; defines the same facet as chi.

potentials.name: k17_total_support_bipartite_component
potentials.description: A potential (not a ray, dim Z = 6) whose tight graph has total support and the bipartite component {8,10}; W + eps (e_8 - e_10) has the same v and the same tight graph for |eps| < 1. Not cited in the paper.

potentials.name: k17_cover_without_total_support
potentials.description: The previous potential with eps = 1, halved: a tight permutation, no total support, and an allowed edge on every anti-diagonal (so the symmetric-dual theorem applies with w != u). Not a facet. Not cited in the paper.

potentials.name: k22_R5
potentials.description: Member m = 5 of the family R(m) below: a facet ray of hat-P(22) without total support. Not cited in the paper.

families.name: R(m)
families.claim: for 5 <= m <= 24 (k = 22..41), R(m) is a facet ray without total support; R(3), R(4) are not rays. Exact check (scripts/check_facets_without_total_support.py); not cited in the paper.
